verdict.rationale: RudderStack's own docs cover each part of the story: Live Events for viewing source and destination events in near real-time, a Health Dashboard for pipeline metrics, Alerts for critical data issues, and MCP tooling to investigate destination delivery errors with root cause analysis. Each feature, however, appears only as a one-line index entry, with no detail on depth or per-destination granularity. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on per-destination delivery-failure views and metric breakdowns, details of alert channels and conditions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can watch events flow live and diagnose delivery failures per destination — debugger views, delivery metrics, and alerting

citations.quote: Live Events View your source and destination events in near real-time
Health Dashboard Monitor your data pipelines and get key metrics at a glance
Alerts Get notified for critical data issues
Investigate destination delivery errors and get root cause analysis
Debug delivery errors, monitor pipelines, write and test transformations, review audit logs — all through natural language.
